summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K to notify holders of its US$1,000,000,000 5.875% perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities (callable September 2026) of its election to exercise an optional redemption in whole on 28 September 2026, at par (US$1,000 per US$1,000 principal) plus accrued and unpaid interest to the redemption date. The securities will be delisted from Euronext Dublin's Global Exchange Market. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation; no premium, advisor, or strategic element is present. Watch for settlement mechanics and potential reissuance of capital securities.
